title: Tittle-Tattle
summary: TIT'TLE-TATTLE, noun [tattle, doubled.] 1. Idle trifling talk; empty prattle. 2. An idle trifling talker. [Less proper.] TIT'TLE-TATTLE, verb intransitive To talk idly; to prate.
